concept: Direct Connect + IPsec VPN: encrypted private link
tests: How to encrypt on-premises ↔ VPC traffic over a dedicated private link with consistent bandwidth (choose two).
expected: AWS Direct Connect (dedicated private connection, consistent throughput) + IPsec VPN over Direct Connect (encryption). Triggers: "encrypted", "private, dedicated connection", "consistent throughput".
why_not: Site-to-Site VPN over the internet alone — no dedicated consistent link; an internet gateway makes the traffic public.
